conf.description: Zscaler ZIA Firewall log (syslog-kv / SPLUNK CIM name=value): structural key=value decode only; field-level ECS mapping is a gap because keys are the admin's editable token selection

conf.comment: Zscaler ZIA Firewall log, syslog-kv (SPLUNK CIM name=value), direct route. This dataset supplies no field rows (fields: []) for this format: the on-wire key/column names are operator-defined by the NSS Feed Output Format template, not a fixed vendor schema, and the work order's own mnemonic hints are inconsistent (e.g. web CEF notes name 'eurl' in one place, 'ehost'+'b64url' in another for what may be the same token). Per the brief, no field-level ECS rename is attempted here - only structural decode plus event.dataset. Field-level mapping is a gap - see README. This is the most edit-tolerant text preset (a dropped token just drops its key, no column shift), but key names are still the admin's choice, so field-level ECS mapping is still not attempted.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose and the operator-defined-keys gap
Explode the name=value pairs directly out of _raw into top-level fields
Tag event.dataset; _raw kept since field-level mapping is not attempted for this format
